remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Not recorded Whitney Archive. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 21. Completed in New York or Virginia before August move to Texas. See cat. no. 85. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Cloudy billows of blue spread across a field of red in this abstract work. The blue forms are outlined in black paint, filling the lower right corner of the composition.
